title: eludite.agents.provider_set input
description: Add an OpenAI-compatible server to the Agents window, or change one (by `name`): the entry in `agents.json`'s `providers` and its key in the credential store (`provider:<name>`). Dangerous: it stores a credential. The audit record and every log line show `apiKey` as `<redacted>`.

name.description: The server's name: unique, shown as the agent's name in the Agents window, and the credential key `provider:<name>`.

baseUrl.description: The API root ending in the version segment, such as `http://localhost:8080/v1` (llama.cpp) or `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`; the adapter appends `/models` and `/chat/completions` and strips one trailing slash.

apiKey.description: The key, kept in the credential store and never in a file. Absent: keep the stored key; empty: delete it (the server is then sent no `Authorization` header).

defaultModel.description: The model a new session starts with; else the first one the server lists.

headers.description: Extra request headers sent to the server, such as OpenRouter's `HTTP-Referer` and `X-Title`. Never `Authorization`: the key is kept in the credential store.

models.description: The person's model catalog, for a server that does not list its models (or to name them and give their context windows). A server with a catalog is never asked for its list.

id.description: The model id the server takes in `model`.

name.description: The name the model picker shows; the id when absent.

contextWindow.description: The model's context window in tokens; 0 or absent: unknown (the usage strip shows no bar).

allowFileStore.description: The person agreed to keep the key in a file only they can read (mode 0600) under Eludite's config directory, used only when the operating system's credential store is unavailable (brief 0046's rule). Without it such a save fails with `store_unavailable` and the dialog asks.

tools.description: `core` (the default): the core tool set plus the meta tool `eludite-tools`, for small context windows; `all`: every agent-visible command.
